info.description: Set `baseUrl` to the gateway (http://<EC2-1 public IP>:8000 or http://localhost:8000) and `adminKey` to ADMIN_REGISTRATION_KEY, then run the folders in order (right-click collection -> Run). Tokens and ids are stored automatically.

request.description: Shows whether each of the 8 downstream services is reachable from the gateway.

exec: pm.test('status is 201 (created) or 409 (already exists from an earlier run)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([201, 409]));

item.name: 9 - Load balancing (set Iterations = 30 and run this folder)
Catalog via gateway - which replica answered?

request.description: Each response carries X-Served-By (the replica) and X-Upstream (the instance the gateway chose). Run this folder with 30 iterations; the console shows the running count per replica.

exec: console.log('X-Served-By:', who, ' | X-Upstream:', pm.response.headers.get('X-Upstream'), ' | totals:', JSON.stringify(counts));
const total = Object.values(counts).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
if (total >= 6) pm.test('traffic is spread over more than one replica', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(counts).length).to.be.above(1));
